comments: This license is largely similar to BSD-3-Clause, but notably includes an additional paragraph between the three main clauses and the all-caps disclaimer text.

evidence.locator: text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted") subject to conditions 1-3; the broad non-reciprocal grant identifies a permissive family

text: opening grant, conditions 1-3, and the additional patent/IP paragraph; no same-license, source-disclosure, corresponding-source, linking, or network-use condition is stated, so the permission is non-reciprocal

text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"); no purpose or field-of-use limitation is stated, and no express sublicensing or patent grant appears

text: conditions 1-2 (source redistributions must retain the copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer; binary redistributions must reproduce the same materials in this license in documentation and/or other materials)

text: conditions 1-2 (notice-retention/reproduction duties attach to source or binary redistribution); modification alone has no separate condition, and no combination, linking, network-use, or patent-claim trigger is stated

text: condition 3 (copyright-holder and contributor names may not endorse or promote derived products without specific prior written permission); additional paragraph disclaims reassurance against third-party patent/IP claims and liability; final paragraph disclaims warranties and limits liability

text: additional paragraph ("provide no reassurances that the source code provided does not infringe any patent") and complete license text; no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause is stated
text: conditions 1-2 require retaining/reproducing the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer for source and binary redistributions (standard two-surface notice burden)
